content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Writes personal homeowners and condo property for individuals in coastal areas, not commercial coverage for small and medium-sized businesses."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Its specialty commercial property and casualty insurance business matches the target's model, though its annuity arm differs."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty commercial property, casualty and professional liability for businesses through brokers, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"An insurance broker earning commissions and fees, not a carrier underwriting and bearing risk."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"An online health and Medicare marketplace earning carrier commissions; it does not underwrite business property or casualty risk."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer insurance leads and quote referrals to carriers and agencies; it takes no underwriting risk."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells annuities and life insurance to individuals for retirement, a different customer and product set from business P&C."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites commercial property and liability for small businesses and contractors through independent agents, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Its core business is title insurance and mortgage guaranty for homebuyers and lenders, unlike the target's small-business P&C focus."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Core business is individual life insurance, mortgages and cemeteries, serving consumers rather than businesses."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Core business is title insurance, escrow and real estate data for property transactions, not business P&C coverage."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"A brokerage earning commissions and service fees for placing coverage, not an underwriting carrier bearing risk."}]}
